bug_info.bug_desc: In the alert_handler_reg_wrap module, the alert ping enable output was computed as alert_en_shadowed[q] AND alert_regwen[q]. This is logically inverted: alert_regwen asserted high indicates that the alert configuration is still writable/unlocked, whereas ping testing is only allowed when the alert is enabled and its configuration is locked (alert_regwen is 0). As a result, ping testing would be enabled in the unlocked state and disabled in the locked state, contradicting the spec requirement that ping-enable is asserted only when the alert is both enabled and locked.
bug_info.fix_hint: Invert the lock/regwen term when generating alert_ping_en. Change the assignment to use ~reg2hw.alert_regwen[k].q instead of reg2hw.alert_regwen[k].q, so that ping is enabled only when the alert is enabled and the configuration register is locked. Apply the same fix in both the template and autogen copies of alert_handler_reg_wrap.sv.
